thread:
jamal: FYI customer reports promo code accepted on checkout modal but balance remains 0. org: acme-dev (org_8421). promo: SPRING50. attached screenshot from UI and webhook response.

customer_acme: Hi, I applied SPRING50 and the UI showed 'code applied' but my usage/balance still shows $0. Please help — needed for a demo tomorrow.

jamal: Thanks, can you share the checkout confirmation ID? Also any email confirmation?

customer_acme: confirmation_id: ch_5K8gO, I got the modal success and an email that says grant created.

jamal: grabbing logs now. Sara, can you check ledger and grants ingestion? I see webhook acked but no balance change.

sara: Could be one of three things: (1) grant created but linked to a user instead of org, (2) grant created but status=queued and ingestion worker failed, (3) grant created in a different org (bad org mapping). Sending what I pulled.

sara: Webhook payload (redacted):
```
{\n  "event":"promo_redeem",\n  "promo":"SPRING50",\n  "amount":50,\n  "recipient":{ "type":"user", "id":"usr_999" },\n  "confirmation_id":"ch_5K8gO"\n}
```

sara: Ledger query: `select id, org_id, user_id, amount, status from grants where confirmation_id='ch_5K8gO';`
Result: `grant_9876 | NULL | usr_999 | 50 | applied_at IS NULL`

ops-bot: ingestion-service: ERROR processing grant_9876: missing org_id, skipping apply. (logs: /var/logs/ingestion/ingest-2024-05-07.log)

jamal: OK that explains it — grant exists but never applied because org_id was null. Do we know why recipient.type==user? Customer redeemed while email not yet linked to org?

maria: Looking at the audit trail — the redemption came from the hosted flow where the user had created the account but hadn't been assigned to org_8421 (SSO race). The webhook used `recipient.user` since the frontend didn't have org context. We need to re-link the grant to org_8421 and trigger the ingestion/apply step.

maria: Proposed fix: run a targeted update + requeue job. Steps: 1) `update grants set org_id='org_8421' where id='grant_9876' and org_id is null;` 2) `POST /internal/jobs/reapply-grant` payload `{ "grant_id":"grant_9876" }` to ingestion service. I will test in staging first.

sara: Please include a rollback plan and confirm the grant wasn't already applied elsewhere. Also check `ledger_entries` for duplicates.

maria: Confirmed no existing ledger_entries for grant_9876. Staging run looks good: grant applied, ledger entry created, balance incremented. Command I ran in staging: 
```
-- staging
UPDATE grants SET org_id='org_8421' WHERE id='grant_9876' AND org_id IS NULL;
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_INTERNAL" \
  https://internal.redwood/api/jobs/reapply-grant -d '{"grant_id":"grant_9876"}'
```

maria: Running same in prod now (will monitor). ETA ~45s.

ops-bot: prod-workers: job reapply-grant started for grant_9876 on worker-13.

sara: Watching ledger.

ops-bot: ledger-service: created ledger_entry le_4411 for grant_9876 (+50). New balance for org_8421: 50.00

jamal: Notifying customer.

customer_acme: I see the $50 credit now, thank you!! :tada: This fixes my demo.

jamal: Closing case after wrap-up. Notes for postmortem: make webhook redemption attach org context when available; add guard to ingestion to lookup user's org if recipient.user provided and email domain matches org; add telemetry for `grant.created with null org_id`.

maria: Filed follow-up ticket: INT-2483 (automate user->org fallback, ping on null org_id).

jamal: Thx all. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
